article_title: B.C. Reg. 158/2026 – British Columbia Securities Commission
body:
Regulation: B.C. Reg. 158/2026
Made under: Energy Resource Activities Act
Published in: No. 16 – B.C. Regs. 153 to 162, September 22, including September 8, 2026
Deposit date: September 14, 2026

B.C. Reg. 158/2026, deposited September 14, 2026, under theENERGY RESOURCE ACTIVITIES ACT[section 112]. Regulation of the Board of the British Columbia Energy Regulator, dated September 11, 2026. The board of the British Columbia Energy Regulator orders that the Renewable Energy Projects Regulation, B.C. Reg. 28/2026, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule. — N. KIERNAN,Chair, Board of Directors. 1	Section 13.5 (2) (b) of the Renewable Energy Projects Regulation, B.C. Reg. 28/2026, is repealed and the following substituted: (b)	in the case of a licence with a term greater than 2 years, the lesser of (ii)	the sum of $7 500 and $10 for each hectare above 500 ha. minutes_briefs.title: BC changes licence fees for renewable energy projects, capping charges for large sites
minutes_briefs.summary: BC Regulation 158/2026 amends the Renewable Energy Projects Regulation (B.C. Reg. 28/2026). It changes how much a licence fee costs for renewable energy projects with a term longer than two years. Under the new rule, the fee is the lesser of two amounts, one of which is $7,500 plus $10 for each hectare above 500 hectares. The regulation was deposited on September 14, 2026 and published in the September 22, 2026 gazette.
minutes_briefs.action_required: If you hold or plan to apply for a renewable energy project licence longer than two years, check your fee calculation against the new $7,500 plus $10 per hectare above 500 ha formula.
